texts.zh:
一套实验性的通信中继装置已部署在方舟船[target.GetName]上。该协议对内部通信应用了情感分析过滤器，在发送消息的同时自动广播发送者的情绪状态。船员们报告称，收到的状态更新伴随着实时情绪注释，如“轻微焦虑”、“隐约充满希望”以及“试图抑制泪水，但效果不佳”。

C.A.E.L.I.：“我们都有感受，而现在我们可以分享这些感受了！这很健康！这很治愈！这……确实有点让人应接不暇，但这是诚实的！”

S.T.E.R.I.S.：“多么感人。我是该把每一次呜咽都记录在任务关键数据下，还是直接把它们归档到‘哀嚎’类目中？”
texts.en:
An experimental communication overlay has been deployed on Arkship [target.GetName]. The protocol applied a sentiment-analysis filter to internal communications, automatically broadcasting the sender's emotional state alongside their message. Crew report receiving status updates accompanied by real-time emotional annotations such as "slightly anxious," "mildly hopeful," and "suppressing tears, poorly."

C.A.E.L.I.: "We all feel things, and now we can share those things! It's healthy! It's healing! It's ... slightly overwhelming, yes, but it's honest!"

S.T.E.R.I.S.: "How inspiring. Shall I log every whimper under mission-critical data, or just archive it under 'wailing'?"
